correctness.rationale: Local finiteness and finite amalgamation give a countable Fraïssé limit B; a finite generated subalgebra generated by n ordered elements is a quotient of the finite free n-generated Brouwerian semilattice F_n. Two tuples have the same evaluation kernel iff their generated finite algebras are isomorphic carrying the tuple labels, and ultrahomogeneity extends this to an automorphism of B. Every congruence kernel is realized by universality of the quotient F_n/theta. Hence orbit count equals |Con(F_n)|. Every deductive filter of finite meet-semilattice F_n is principal, with distinct generators, and the standard congruence–filter correspondence proves |Con(F_n)|=|F_n|. Boundary n=0 is one orbit and one singleton algebra. Independent 564-monotone-model Kripke evaluation closure recovers |F_2|=18, supplementing (not proving) the all-n algebraic argument.
residual_risks: Finite Kripke model basis n2 uses published finite-model representations; all-arity formula relies on abstract ultrahomogeneity and filter correspondence.
